_comment: Curated, version-pinned catalog of Wan2GP community plugins. Author = GKartist75 (Wan2GP Desktop Launcher). Each entry installs into <repo>/plugins/<id> (or <repo>/<installPath> for model/processor plugins). `verified` flags whether the repo URL has been confirmed against the upstream source — the catalog service refuses to clone an unverified entry and surfaces it in the UI. Adjust `repo`/`tag` before flipping verified true.

plugins.name: Finetune Manager
plugins.author: GKartist75
plugins.summary: Community finetune registry: browse, load, create, edit, improve, and upload finetune JSONs for Wan2GP.

plugins.name: File Gallery
plugins.author: Tophness and Neires
plugins.summary: Gallery tab: view metadata of all files in output folders, join video frames with a single click, and more.

plugins.name: HideUI
plugins.author: MrKuenning
plugins.summary: Toggle UI elements on/off in Wan2GP.

plugins.name: Image Suite
plugins.author: saintorphan
plugins.summary: Image workbench: Txt2Img, Img2Img, MultiCanvas, Modify editor for Flux/Z-Image/SDXL.

plugins.name: LoRA Manager
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.summary: Manage local LoRAs with lset support and granular prompt/file injection.

plugins.name: LoRA Merger
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.summary: Advanced LoRA Merger with granular block control and drift visualization.

plugins.name: Lora Multipliers UI
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.summary: Dynamically set lora multipliers with a fast JavaScript-powered UI.

plugins.name: Lora Organizer
plugins.author: ppc2017
plugins.summary: Organize loras into groups/subgroups, store metadata, activate with trigger words + strength.

plugins.name: LTX Director
plugins.author: The-ShadowWalker
plugins.summary: Timeline editor: sliding-window bands, WanGP relay, real waveforms with audio playback.

plugins.name: Multi-Angle Prompt Helper
plugins.author: CodeBarrie
plugins.summary: 3D orbit gizmo + prompt helper for multi-angle camera control.

plugins.name: Prompt Library
plugins.author: saintorphan
plugins.summary: Standalone, model-agnostic prompt library in the Media Generation tab.

plugins.name: Prompt Manager
plugins.author: David Brum
plugins.summary: Browse generated media with search/sort/grid, saved library with export/import, bulk actions.

plugins.name: Pulsebar
plugins.author: Javier-bat
plugins.summary: Windows floating always-on-top progress bar for Wan2GP generations.

plugins.name: Queue Editor
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.summary: Advanced/bulk queue.zip operations offline without affecting the main generator queue.

plugins.name: Queue Notifier
plugins.author: Javier-bat
plugins.summary: Queue notifier with Apprise channels (Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/IFTTT/Google Chat) + media attachments.

plugins.name: Stable Diffusion 1.4 Model Plugin
plugins.author: DeepBeepMeep
plugins.summary: Template model plugin that adds Stable Diffusion 1.4 through WanGP's model-plugin discovery path.

plugins.name: VRAM / RAM Adjuster
plugins.author: Unknown
plugins.summary: Adjust GPU VRAM and System RAM — override the memory profiles.

plugins.name: Pixel Upsampler Template
plugins.author: DeepBeepMeep
plugins.summary: Template spatial upsampler plugin that duplicates pixels and documents the WanGP upsampler API.

plugins.name: wan2gp-blender-upsampler
plugins.author: DeepBeepMeep
plugins.summary: Template temporal upsampler plugin that creates x2 intermediate frames by blending neighboring frames.
